'''Interstellar Collections Limited''' was a galactic collections agency. It was a very busy agency during the height of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and was responsible for maintaining the [[Red List/Legends|Red List]], an extensive tracking of checks and balances which served as a way to keep record of outstanding debts. Under the Empire, the agency became extremely powerful. Their [[Skip tracer/Legends|skip tracers]] soon had the power to settle debts by repossessing an individual's belongings with little or no notice. The agency served both the Empire and the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] in recording and tracking all major debts and those involved.<ref name="HSR" />
